claim: Depth of field is the fastest character-from-background separation there is, and it decides whether the world is a place or a texture. Deep keeps the stadium a fact; very_shallow deletes it and leaves only a boy and some coloured light.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: deep focus, everything in focus, sharp background
moderate depth of field, slightly soft background
depth of field, blurry background, bokeh
extremely shallow depth of field, heavily blurred background, bokeh
split diopter, foreground and background both sharp, split focus

review.issue: medium ("moderate depth of field, slightly soft background") sits between the two states Animagine actually has — "deep focus" and "blurry background" — and will not separate from deep. split_diopter has essentially no representation in the model and will most likely come back as ordinary deep focus, a second copy of the deep panel.
review.fix: Reduce to deep / shallow / very_shallow. Keep split_diopter only with an explicit note in the card that it is the one value the still pass is expected to miss (it is really an ffmpeg/composite job), or mark it as a per-option skip.
